title: Prove conditional native terminal source-response factorization
body:
The scalar F0→F2 terminal quotient in #2564 left its native extension open. This package proves conditional source-response factorization through the first eight complete native centre fields for the selected two-ablation prefix, including all 11 local sweeps, four bridges and four idle sweeps.

For the complete prefix F and its two-centre-ablation diagnostic A, with arbitrary other contents h held fixed, define:

```text
E_D d = (F-A)(d,h) - (F-A)(0,h)
P_D d = first eight complete native pre-transport centre-field responses

ker(P_D) ⊆ ker(E_D), hence E_D = L_native P_D.
```

Exact signed boundary identities cancel the X0 response at B1. The actual chronology then leaves only 112 target and 99 helper input roles live at F2, and its eight pre-centre rows have zero coefficients on every one of those roles. The proof compares complete terminal continuations.

Start with the [proof and scope](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f122d255c4cdb0714c079d8e91b76bd7a34da23e/research/centre-native-terminal-factor/README.md) and [validation record](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f122d255c4cdb0714c079d8e91b76bd7a34da23e/research/centre-native-terminal-factor/VALIDATION.md). Only the new `research/centre-native-terminal-factor/` package is changed.

The result inherits the declared complete native common-frame and cover/local-view interface. Eight complete fields include cover-owner, payload and spectator indices. This does not establish sharp native rank eight, recover the dirty offset, supply a paid decoder, rebuild the physical compiler, reduce the centre invoice or change κ. The next useful step is a concrete, fully charged dirty residual consumer.

Validation on Linux x86_64 / CPython 3.12.14, using only the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-native-terminal-factor
python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/centre-native-terminal-factor
```

- All three registered checks passed in 100.148 seconds: complete local/native-operator premises; 4,032 exact signed 73-axis boundary identities; and an independent reverse-adjoint derivation of 1,408 endpoint rows and eight centre rows.
- A relocated read-only export without Git metadata passed all three commands. Source corruption and integer-to-float receipt corruption were rejected.
- Independent and skeptical Codex reviews were completed. A cost-unit wording error and a wrapper-sensitive mutation-control placement were corrected; affected evidence was replayed. No material review finding remains within the stated conditional scope.
- Committed-byte verification passed for all 22 package/input files. All 12 published package blobs were read back from GitHub and matched the reviewed commit.

Remote CI is separate from these local results. The last inspected fork snapshot was not clean and still had running/queued jobs. Three inspected failures concern historical source-pin checks involving `scripts/run_parallel.py`, `scripts/verify_hpe_lean_binding.py` and `scripts/partial_swap/shared.py`, all unchanged by this contribution. Other failures were not individually diagnosed; no complete remote-CI pass is claimed.
